title: Apollo 11 Powered Descent — Program Alarm Reference
status: source-bounded reference fixture; runtime not yet implemented
research_boundaries: Reference events are actual-flight chronology, not a reconstruction of the final preflight SimSup case.
The separate preflight simulation is documented, but Richard Koos could not recall whether its injected alarm was 1201 or 1202.
No Apollo 11 descent runtime, trajectory model, radar model, LGC restart model, or station presentation is implied by this fixture.
Touchdown and manual landing after P66 are outside this initial reference interval.
sources: NASA, Apollo 11 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/static/history/alsj/a11/a11transcript_tec.pdf
NASA Oral History Project, Richard H. Koos interview, 24 August 2023: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/koosrh-8-24-23.pdf
